zh: 最近身边有不少朋友，都来问我：我也想学AI，到底怎么从AI里面赚到钱？
en: Many friends ask me: I want to learn AI too. How can I make money with AI?

zh: 但我发现，大家真正想问的是我们就在西北、就在兰州，至少在很多普通人的体感里，AI还没有出现沿海城市那种大规模爆发，我们到底该不该学？从哪里开始学？又怎样把AI用到自己的工作和生活里？
en: But what people really want to know is this: we are here in northwest China, here in Lanzhou. For many people, AI has not yet exploded like it has in coastal cities. Should we learn it? Where do we start? And how do we use AI in work and life?

zh: 更现实一点说，普通人现在学AI，到底是不是机会？
en: More realistically, is learning AI still an opportunity for ordinary people?

zh: 这期我先帮你把自己的起点判断清楚，再讲两条真正能落地的路：一条是用AI改善现有工作，另一条是用AI做动漫、漫剧和AIGC内容。
en: First, I will help you identify your starting point, then share two practical paths: use AI to improve your current work, or use AI to create animation, short animation dramas, and AIGC content.

zh: 你先问自己一个问题：你学AI，是因为手上的工作已经忙不过来了，想解决一个具体的能力短板？ 还是因为每天都看到别人学AI，网上铺天盖地，自己开始焦虑，但还说不清到底想解决什么？
en: Ask yourself: are you learning AI because your work is too much and you need to solve a real skill gap? Or are you anxious because everyone online seems to be learning AI, while you still cannot say what problem you want to solve?

zh: 还有一类人，手里已经有一个能落地的项目，动漫、漫剧或者AIGC创意，想借AI真正把它做出来。
en: There is another group: they already have a viable animation, short drama, or AIGC idea and want to bring it to life with AI.

zh: 这三种情况，都叫“我想学AI”，但起点完全不是一回事。 有具体工作问题，就从一项真实任务开始；手里有明确创意，就从一个小样片开始；如果只是焦虑、还没有目标，先别买一堆课，也别急着堆工具，先把你想改变的结果说清楚。
en: All three situations sound like “I want to learn AI,” but the starting points are completely different. Start with a real task, a small sample, or first clarify the result you want to change.

zh: 先说工作这一条。
en: Let us start with work.

zh: 截至2025年12月，我国生成式人工智能用户规模已经达到6.02亿，普及率达到42.8%。但在更早一份报告里，用户最主要的使用目的还是回答问题，占80.9%。
en: By December 2025, China had 602 million generative AI users, with a 42.8% penetration rate. An earlier report showed that answering questions was still the main use, at 80.9%.

zh: 这两个数字放在一起看，说明接触AI的人已经很多了，但会问问题，和让AI稳定参与一项真实工作，中间还有一段距离。
en: Together, these numbers show that many people have met AI, but asking questions and having AI reliably participate in real work are still very different things.

zh: 企业也是一样。工信部面向中小企业征集AI应用，列出的不是几个热词，而是研发设计、生产维护、质量检测、采购供应、营销售后和运营管理这些真实环节。
en: The same is true for companies. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology lists real steps such as R&D, maintenance, quality inspection, procurement, sales, after-sales service, and operations.

zh: 所以普通人学AI的基础，不一定先是代码，也不一定先是背一百个提示词。
en: So the foundation for ordinary people is not necessarily code, or memorizing a hundred prompts.

zh: 咋们先要学会五件事： 第一，我到底要解决什么问题？ 第二，这件事的输入是什么，中间要做哪些判断，最后交付什么？ 第三，哪些资料可以给AI，哪些资料不能上传？ 第四，什么样才算做对，谁来验收？ 第五，这次错在哪里，下一次能不能沉淀成模板、清单或者固定动作？
en: We need to learn five things: what problem to solve, what the input and judgment steps are, what data can be shared, how success is checked, and how mistakes become reusable templates or routines.

zh: 比如你想让AI帮你整理客户咨询，不要只说“帮我提高效率”。 你要说清楚：这是过去一周的客户咨询，最后要交回问题分类、跟进名单和会议清单，敏感信息已经脱敏，交付前由我逐条核对。
en: For example, if you want AI to organize customer inquiries, do not just say “make me more efficient.” Define the source, the deliverables, the privacy boundary, and the final human check.

zh: 这就形成了一个最小闭环：原始输入，AI第一版，人工检查，交付结果，记录错误。
en: That creates a minimum loop: raw input, an AI first draft, human review, delivery, and an error record.

zh: 当这个动作重复了很多次，标准也稳定了，你再考虑模板、技能、智能体、自动化或者代码。 没有真实任务，先堆工具，往往只是增加学习负担。
en: Repeat it until the standard is stable, then consider templates, skills, agents, automation, or code. Without a real task, collecting tools only adds learning burden.

zh: 那如果想做动漫、漫剧、AIGC内容呢？
en: What if you want to make animation, short dramas, or AIGC content?

zh: 这确实是一个值得研究的市场，但市场大，不等于个人做了就能赚钱。
en: It is a market worth studying, but a big market does not mean an individual will automatically make money.

zh: 中国互联网络信息中心发布的报告显示，2025年上半年我国微短剧用户达到6.26亿。
en: A CNNIC report says that China had 626 million short-drama users in the first half of 2025.

zh: 北京市广播电视局发布的《2025年北京微短剧研究报告》披露，2025年中国微短剧全年产值约1000亿元，相关存续企业超过35万家。
en: A 2025 Beijing report estimates China’s annual short-drama output at about 100 billion yuan, with more than 350,000 active related companies.

zh: 国家广播电视总局公布的2025年全年国产网络剧片发行许可情况里，网络动画片603部、6657集，重点微短剧691部、19848集。
en: In 2025, approved online animation reached 603 titles and 6,657 episodes; key short dramas reached 691 titles and 19,848 episodes.

zh: 这些信息能证明用户、企业、作品和产业链都已经存在，但不能证明你有一个创意，就会自然获得播放、分账、平台推荐或者资方投资。
en: These figures prove that users, companies, works, and an industry chain exist. They do not prove that one idea will naturally get views, revenue sharing, recommendations, or investment.

zh: 很多人做AIGC漫剧，第一步就错了：先生成一堆漂亮图片，然后以为自己已经开始做漫剧。
en: Many people start AIGC short dramas the wrong way: they generate beautiful pictures first and think the drama has already begun.

zh: 其实漫剧的最低交付，不是几张好看的图，而是一个能看懂的样片：一句话故事，角色设定，六到十二个镜头，声音，剪辑，最后完成一个完整动作。
en: The minimum deliverable is not a few beautiful images. It is an understandable sample: a one-line story, character design, six to twelve shots, sound, editing, and one complete action.

zh: 第一阶段先做30到60秒，不要一上来就做几十集。
en: In the first stage, make 30 to 60 seconds. Do not start with dozens of episodes.

zh: 通过标准也很简单：观众能不能看懂，人物能不能大体保持，镜头能不能接上，声音能不能听清，成本和修改次数有没有记录。
en: The test is simple: can viewers understand it, do characters remain consistent, do shots connect, is the sound clear, and are costs and revisions recorded?

zh: 先说明一个原则：不同平台、不同模型、不同清晰度，不能用一个价格套过去。这里分别拿RunningHub页面上的两个常用模型做示例。
en: One principle first: prices cannot be compared across platforms, models, and resolutions with one universal rate. Here are two common models on RunningHub.

zh: Seedance 2.0选择4K、5秒、无音频、16比9，一次生成页面显示9.15元。
en: Seedance 2.0, 4K, 5 seconds, no audio, 16:9: one generation shows 9.15 yuan.

zh: 如果最终要做20秒，并且拆成4个5秒镜头，那么每个镜头一次生成成功的理想情况下，视频模型调用费就是4乘9.15，等于36.60元。
en: For a 20-second result split into four 5-second shots, one successful generation per shot costs 4 times 9.15, or 36.60 yuan.

zh: 但漫剧很少每个镜头一次就成功。假设每个镜头平均生成4轮，视频模型费就是4个镜头乘4轮，再乘9.15元，等于146.40元。
en: But short dramas rarely succeed on the first try. At four attempts per shot, the video model cost is 4 shots times 4 attempts times 9.15, or 146.40 yuan.

zh: 这只是Seedance 2.0的视频模型调用费，不包括首帧图、角色图、配音、音乐、剪辑、字幕、存储和失败返工。
en: That is only the Seedance 2.0 video-model cost. It excludes keyframes, character images, voice, music, editing, captions, storage, and failed revisions.

zh: Seedance 2.5是另一套模型和价格体系。RunningHub页面示例显示，4K、30秒、无音频、16比9，一次生成75.60元。
en: Seedance 2.5 has a different model and pricing system. A RunningHub example shows 4K, 30 seconds, no audio, 16:9, at 75.60 yuan per generation.

zh: 再往长了算。用Seedance 2.0做60秒样片，假设最终使用12个5秒镜头，每个镜头平均尝试4轮，就是48次5秒生成，视频模型费约439.20元。
en: For a 60-second sample with Seedance 2.0, using twelve 5-second shots and four attempts per shot means 48 generations, costing about 439.20 yuan.

zh: 如果做3分钟试播集，按36个5秒镜头、每个镜头平均尝试4轮计算，就是144次5秒生成，视频模型费约1317.60元。
en: For a 3-minute pilot, using 36 five-second shots and four attempts each means 144 generations, costing about 1,317.60 yuan.

zh: 这还没有包含图片、声音、剪辑、版权、审核和人工时间。真正容易超预算的，往往是角色一致性返工、镜头设计、动作重做、配音音效、后期剪辑和你自己花掉的时间。
en: This still excludes images, sound, editing, copyright, review, and labor. Character consistency, shot design, action retries, voice, sound effects, and post-production often cause the budget to grow.

zh: 如果你本身懂导演思维、镜头和节奏，或者你在某个行业里有内容判断，你的优势就不只是会不会点生成按钮。
en: If you understand directing, shots, rhythm, or content judgment in an industry, your advantage is more than knowing which button to press.

zh: 你知道一场戏为什么这样拍，人物什么时候出现，镜头怎么切，观众应该在几秒钟看懂什么。这会直接影响你的试错方向和返工次数。
en: You know why a scene is shot this way, when a character enters, how to cut, and what viewers should understand in a few seconds. That changes your trial direction and revision count.

zh: 但这不代表可以不花钱。前期还是要投入，只不过要把投入控制在有边界的验证里，而不是一上来就把整部剧做出来。
en: This does not mean you can spend nothing. You still invest early, but keep it inside a bounded validation instead of making the whole series at once.

zh: 普通人进入这个市场，大致有四条路。
en: For ordinary people, there are roughly four ways into this market.

zh: 第一条，自己在家做样片。
en: First: make a sample at home.

zh: 适合有创意、愿意学习、预算有限的人。第一阶段只做一句话故事、角色设定、六到十二个镜头和30到60秒样片。给自己设一个预算上限，达到上限还没有通过，就先停下来复盘，不要继续加钱证明自己一定能做成。
en: This suits people with ideas, a willingness to learn, and limited budgets. Start with a one-line story, character design, six to twelve shots, and a 30-to-60-second sample. Set a budget ceiling and stop to review when you reach it.

zh: 第二条，借助工作室。
en: Second: work with a studio.

zh: 如果有创意或者IP，但不懂分镜、角色资产、生成和后期，可以先买一条样片或一个小试播。
en: If you have an idea or IP but lack storyboards, character assets, generation, and post-production skills, buy a sample or a small pilot first.

zh: 不要只问“多少钱一集”，还要问清楚：交付多少秒，多少镜头，包含几轮修改，角色资产归谁，生成素材能不能商用，配音音乐包不包含，出问题谁返工，最后谁负责审核。
en: Do not ask only “how much per episode?” Ask about seconds, shots, revision rounds, asset ownership, commercial rights, voice and music, rework responsibility, and final review.

zh: 第三条，组一个小团队。
en: Third: build a small team.

zh: 如果自己懂故事、导演或者某个行业内容，但缺技术执行和后期，可以找人合作。
en: If you understand stories, directing, or an industry but lack technical execution and post-production, find collaborators.

zh: 现在咱们兰州本地市场做这些OPC的，或者是AIGC这一块的人，其实还是蛮多的。
en: There are already quite a few OPC and AIGC practitioners in Lanzhou’s local market.

zh: 团队不一定很大，但几个动作不能悬空：创意和编剧谁负责，导演和分镜谁负责，角色和视觉资产谁负责，生成和剪辑谁负责，声音、发布和合规谁负责。
en: The team need not be large, but every action needs an owner: concept, writing, directing, storyboards, character assets, generation, editing, sound, publishing, and compliance.

zh: 先用一个小样片验证沟通和修改，不要只看对方作品集。
en: Use a small sample to test communication and revisions. Do not judge only by a portfolio.

zh: 第四条，去找平台、扶持或者资方。
en: Fourth: look for platforms, support programs, or investors.

zh: 这条路不是没有机会，但只有一句“我有个好想法”通常还不够。至少要准备故事、样片、目标观众、预算、版权证明、执行团队和发行计划。
en: There may be opportunities, but “I have a great idea” is usually not enough. Prepare the story, sample, target audience, budget, rights proof, execution team, and release plan.

zh: 一些扶持项目还会要求原创项目处于创作阶段，完成规划备案，并提交样稿、样片或者主要角色设计。地方支持政策也往往面向符合条件的产业活动单位、法人或非法人组织，具体比例和金额都有条件。
en: Some support programs require an original project in development, planning and filing, plus a draft, sample, or main character designs. Local policies also have eligibility conditions.

zh: 所以，扶持存在，不等于个人发一个想法就能拿到钱。
en: Support programs exist, but that does not mean a personal idea automatically receives funding.

zh: 还有两道边界要提前记住。 第一，微短剧不是生成完就能随便发。公开传播前，要按平台和监管要求核验许可证、备案、审核和责任主体。 第二，AI生成的图片、视频、音频和虚拟场景，发布时要按要求主动声明并完成生成合成内容标识。
en: Remember two boundaries. A short drama cannot be published freely just because it was generated. Check licensing, filing, review, and the responsible party. AI-generated content must also be declared and labeled as required.

zh: 没有授权的小说、游戏、动漫角色、真人肖像、音乐和字体，也不要直接拿来做商业样片。
en: Do not use unauthorized novels, games, anime characters, real-person likenesses, music, or fonts in a commercial sample.

zh: 所以普通人学AI，最后不是先问哪个工具最强。
en: So ordinary people should not start by asking which tool is strongest.

zh: 如果想改善工作，就先完成一项真实任务的小闭环。
en: If you want to improve work, complete one minimum loop for a real task.

zh: 如果想做AIGC漫剧，就先完成一个30到60秒样片，记录生成次数、模型费用、人工时间、返工问题和版权边界。
en: If you want to make an AIGC short drama, complete a 30-to-60-second sample and record generations, model costs, labor time, rework, and rights boundaries.

zh: 样片通过以后，再决定自己做、找工作室、组团队，还是拿着项目去找平台、扶持和资方。
en: After the sample passes, decide whether to work alone, use a studio, build a team, or take the project to a platform, support program, or investor.

zh: 先选结果，再做小样；先记录成本，再扩大投入；先验证创意和协作，再决定要不要烧更大的钱。
en: Choose the result first, make a small sample, record costs before scaling, and validate the idea and collaboration before spending more.

zh: 如果你也在考虑做AI工作流、动漫、漫剧或者AIGC内容，可以在评论区写下：你现在在做什么内容，现在最缺创意、技术、团队还是资金，以及你准备先拿多少预算做样片。
en: If you are considering AI workflows, animation, short dramas, or AIGC content, tell me what you are making, what you lack most, and your sample budget.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao Ge, building an AI business in Lanzhou.
